sections.dramatic_function: Move from abstract fear to a concrete controlled experiment, then state limits.
Separate real reported misuse from capability evaluations.
Contrast forecasts, then shift from employment speculation to power concentration.
Show that regulation is necessary but distributional consequences matter.
Present a genuine trade-off without declaring a simple winner.
Turn diagnosis into technical, procedural and structural safeguards.
Return to the opening question and resolve on human agency.

Put two official safety-framework covers on screen as the first substantive visual evidence.
